claims.description: Conditional local lease-consumption obligation: with fixed two-voter membership including self, an expired prior remote-contact marker and no remote processing or reply during the controlled operation, completion of an unanswered replication timeout must not supply qualifying quorum contact; a subsequent checkLeaderLease invocation must transition a locally Leader node to Follower. This is a no-contact condition, not a requirement that every negative RPC reply be rejected as contact.

scope.description: Local timeout-to-contact-to-lease comparison under explicitly constructed local state, using actual in-memory transport completion and actual Raft consumers.
assumptions: Exactly two Voters, local node and one remote peer; no membership change.
Node initially has local Leader state and a peer-contact marker older than LeaderLeaseTimeout; this is an assumed local prefix, not a claimed elected state.
No receiver Raft processes the queued request and no reply is sent; no other writer changes contact.
Lease check runs after the tested timeout consumer completes; omitted background workers isolate this conditional effect.
excluded: Proof of a legal election/startup history
Automatic lease scheduling or total role-retention duration
Application stale reads, client success, or incorrect log commitment

claims.source: Candidate derived from attributed implementation responsibilities
pending: Formal evidence gap: exploration measured timeout-driven marker refresh and manual lease retention, but is not property Evidence. Submit a scoped checker using an independently justified no-contact oracle.
Initial-prefix gap: Leader state, expired prior contact and two voters are constructed conditional premises; no elected-cluster history or real scheduled lease deadline is established.
Consequence gap: fallback replication, heartbeats, incoming RPCs and verification run in a full node and may change the duration or externally visible result; no application completion is observed.
The earlier higher-term heartbeat-rejection variant still lacks an acquired immediate-step-down requirement and is not covered by the proposed timeout obligation.

grounding.derivation: Config.LeaderLeaseTimeout explicitly promises step-down when the interval elapses without quorum contact. For two Voters, self alone is insufficient. With prior remote contact already expired and an unanswered request never processed by a receiver, no new remote contact exists. Therefore after the timeout consumer completes, a lease decision must not count that completion as contact and must step down. AppendFuture.Response additionally restricts validity to successful Error completion, supporting rejection of failed-future response fields as evidence, but the observed endpoint comparison is the lease decision rather than just API usage. The oracle does not come from the pipeline-versus-ordinary difference.
grounding.applicability: Applies to the actual in-repository in-memory transport implementation and actual checkLeaderLease consumer under stated conditional premises. The config contract is public; its implementation uses contact recency and majority of Voters. A rejected real reply may still be contact and is outside the no-reply antecedent.
unresolved: Whether this conditional prefix occurs in one legal full-node history with protective workers active.
Whether a single refresh postpones externally observable leadership loss; the local invocation alone establishes neither a timing bound nor an application failure.
alternatives: Ordinary replicateTo propagates transport timeout and preserves old contact.
Heartbeat replies, including negative replies, can constitute actual contact; not excluded by this obligation.
Fallback replication, incoming RPCs and negative VerifyLeader responses may force role loss independently; their absence is explicit local scope.

associations.rationale: Connect the public no-contact lease expectation to the actual authority-loss consumer; response validity is supporting evidence, not the sole endpoint.

bindings.description: Consumes per-voter LastContact and changes state on insufficient recent contacts.
pending: Full-node scheduling and legal startup prefix are not established.
